APPROVE
The diff moves the dependency walk, the input predicate and the site construction into helpers, leaving the method well under 15; the logic is preserved exactly (the inverted `reported.Add` check emits sites under the same condition), and it should build provided the parameter types `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation` and `JsInventory.Inventory` match the real types, which I couldn't check because the source isn't on this machine.
